## Event Details

::: {.callout-note}
### Socials
_(Subject to change up to the day of the event)_

---

#### **📌 Poster Session**
- Poster competition (prizes to be announced on the day of the event)
- Poster presentation open air in front of Queen’s Tower (South Kensington Campus) - indoor alternative in case of rain

---

#### **🥐 Welcome Breakfast at Victoria and Albert Museum**
- Breakfast and registration in [Gamble Room]( https://www.vandaimages.com/results.asp?cat1=Gamble+Room&X8=19-02-07) inside the V&A
- Continental breakfast provided by [Benugo](https://www.benugo.com/) for all LOGML participants
- Private tour available for participants from 9:00

---

#### **🧗 Bouldering Night**
- Bouldering, DJ and dinner at [White City Bouldering](https://www.google.com/maps/place/White+City+Bouldering/@51.5094485,-0.2321965,15z/data=!3m1!5s0x48760fd07c4faf0d:0x55f0c588f4d12046!4m6!3m5!1s0x48760f2e75033aaf:0xfc392b5ae678af54!8m2!3d51.5094485!4d-0.2230555!16s%2Fg%2F11pyc5_4hk?hl=de&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDUwNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) from 18:30 to 22:30
- Dinner provided by [Ichiba London](https://www.japancentre.com/en) (Hot and cold japanese food)
- Shoes and chalk are provided
- Introductory courses for beginners are available at the beginning of the night
- 2 bouldering experts available throughout the night
- Full hire of the bouldering gym - open only to LOGML participants

---

#### **🎷 Dinner and Live Music at Blues Kitchen**
- Pub Food, drinks and live music provided to LOGML participants at [Blues Kitchen Shoreditch](https://maps.app.goo.gl/URzxvsk4tvRi7rBy6) from 18:00 to 2:00
- Live music from 21, then DJ and dance floor open for the rest of the night
- Private hire of [tequila bar room](https://hirespace.com/Spaces/London/138578/The-Blues-Kitchen-Shoreditch/Tequila-Bar/Events), accessible only to LOGML participants

---

#### **🧺 Project Presentations in Hyde Park**
- Picnic in Hyde Park - type of food to be confirmed 
- Availability of marquee in case of rain
- Each group will present the results of their weekly projects (around 15 minutes presentations with questions)
:::

---

::: {.callout-note}
### Provisional Titles of Talks  
_(Subject to change up to the day of the event)_

**Filippo Maria Bianchi** (University of Norway) - _‘Hierarchical pooling in Graph Neural Networks’_

**Tolga Birdal** (Imperial College London) - _‘Topological Deep Learning: Going Beyond Graph Data’_

**Coralia Cartis** (Oxford University) - _‘Introduction to Riemannian geometry and optimization for machine learning (Part I)’_

**Estelle Massart** (UCLouvain) - _‘Introduction to Riemannian geometry and optimization for machine learning (Part II)’_

**Marco Cuturi** (Apple / CREST-ENSAE) - _TBD_ 

**Bastian Rieck** (University of Fribourg) - _‘Shapes, Spaces, Simplices, and Structure: Geometry, Topology, and Machine Learning’_

**Francisco J Ruiz** (Google DeepMind) - _‘AI for mathematical and algorithmic discoveries’_

**Alice Barbara Tumpach** (Wolfgang Pauli Institute, Vienna) - _‘Infinite-dimensional Geometry and AI’_

**Marinka Zitnik** (Harvard University) - _‘From molecules to therapies: Scientific discovery in the age of AI’_
:::
